features.feature_value: Moderate punctuation with quoted phrase and multiple clauses
features.evidence_span: Well to them "traditional family values" entails a system where men aren't held accountable for abuse towards their spouses.
features.rationale: The post uses direct quotation marks around a contested phrase and dense multi-clause structure with strong evaluative wording.

features.feature_value: Inferential causal reasoning from two observations
features.evidence_span: Illegal aliens work under the table. Poor people get free government healthcare. Let's put two and two together.
features.rationale: It explicitly links two asserted facts via an inference trope to imply wrongdoing.

features.feature_value: Definitions via explicit contrasts (not X, but Y) and doctrinal argument
features.evidence_span: I said it GRANTS no rights, not that it doesn't acknowledge one.
features.rationale: The text repeatedly uses “not … but …” style definitional contrasts to structure the argument.

features.feature_value: Persuasive framing urging against reciprocal double standards
features.evidence_span: It sucks MAGA has double standards, but that doesn't mean we should hold them too.
features.rationale: It contains an explicit normative conclusion about what people should or should not do.

features.feature_value: School shootings/gun reform and solutions debate
features.evidence_span: stop school shootings just to justify everyone can have guns when basic gun reform would help.
features.rationale: The primary subject is gun violence prevention and gun policy.

features.feature_value: Attribution of disregard to a party using moral outrage language
features.evidence_span: The gop don't care about children getting shot.
features.rationale: It uses a stark motive/intent claim (“don’t care”) directed at an in-group/out-group.
The post explicitly solicits audience support for a political initiative.

features.feature_value: Direct attack on Elon Musk with “delusional/obession” and “taxpayer-subsidized scam”
features.evidence_span: Elon Musk's delusional obsession with so-called 'sustainable' energy is just a taxpayer-subsidized scam
features.rationale: It targets a prominent elite figure with negative characterization and alleges fraud/scam motives.
